svg.desc: Red means now. Lavender means you. Everything else is a dark stage that lets imagery do the talking. #FF0049 and #DDBEF0 are observed brand hues; all other values are reconstructed approximations. · Wake, A Glance-inspired design system. Original vector artwork; not a Glance asset.
